iteration_ceiling.description: Hard ceiling; halt fires when iteration_count > iteration_ceiling. Default 150.

usd_spent.description: Cumulative cost in USD. Computed PostToolUse from CQR price table.

usd_ceiling.description: Hard cost ceiling; halt fires when usd_spent > usd_ceiling.

hash_window.description: Last 10 canonical sha256 hashes; rolling FIFO.

hash_collisions.description: Count of duplicate hashes in the current 10-call window. Halt fires at 3.
